verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents a dedicated integrations section where each adapter gives the agent one persistent browser plus `run`, `snapshot` and `screenshot` tools. Documented adapters cover CrewAI (StagehandTool and a server-backed integration), LangChain's Deep Agents, and Claude Code via MCP/stdio. missing for 10: documented Vercel AI SDK adapter, explicit Claude Agent SDK (vs. Claude Code) adapter, independent or hands-on corroboration of the adapters.
